decisions.reason: As a flagship product in our move toward efficient, application-specific lighting, it appears to be meeting or at least staying close enough to our aspirations to justify continued support after the first portfolio review.

We would keep this niche marine searchlight for another year because our specialist-lighting capabilities and available slack allow further learning, even though its HMI technology fits less well with our LED-led direction and leaves it comparatively vulnerable.

This marine searchlight still fits our established strengths in robust specialist lighting, and after surviving the initial pruning there is not enough sign of an aspiration shortfall to redeploy its resources yet.
